name: Oxfordshire
metaTitle: Garden designers and landscapers in Oxfordshire | Morgan Oates
metaDescription: Garden design, landscaping and maintenance in Oxfordshire, from a Cheltenham studio working across the Cotswolds.
sub: Garden design, landscaping and maintenance across the Oxfordshire Cotswolds and beyond.
intro: The Cotswolds run on into Oxfordshire, and so does our work. From the limestone villages around Burford and Chipping Norton to the river valleys further south and east, every garden starts with the house, the stone and the view.
pa: The county changes as you cross it, from Cotswold limestone in the north and west to clay and chalk further south and east, so we look at your own plot before deciding what to build and plant. If your house is listed or in a conservation area, we check what that means for walls and buildings before the design is fixed.
work: Based in Cheltenham, we work across the Cotswolds, including the Oxfordshire side around Burford, Charlbury and Chipping Norton. Tell us your postcode and what you have in mind, and we will say how we can help.
ctaHead: Tell us about your Oxfordshire garden.

intro: Swindon brings together the old town, the railway village and open countryside, and its gardens are just as varied. We design and build gardens that suit the house and the street, from compact town plots to larger family gardens.
pa: Much of Swindon sits on clay, so drainage and planting are planned around how your own plot behaves through the seasons. Some parts of the town are conservation areas, which we look into before anything is drawn.
work: Swindon is one of the places Morgan Oates works, alongside the Cotswolds and Oxfordshire. Send us your postcode and a few lines about the garden, and we will take it from there.

intro: Wokingham's gardens are lived in: family lawns, mature trees and borders that have to work all year. We design and build them around how you use the space, and look after them once they are finished.
pa: The ground here runs from clay to sandy, acidic soil, so planting is chosen to suit what you actually have. We also check early for protected trees, so a design never depends on work that will not be allowed.
work: Wokingham is another place Morgan Oates works, alongside the Cotswolds and London. Give us your postcode and a short description of the plot, and we will be in touch.

intro: London gardens are small, walled and often hard to reach, which makes every decision count. Our London work includes a Japanese-style garden with a pond and gazebo, a planted basement entrance in central London and a walled garden in the west of the city.
pa: Most London gardens are shaded, walled and overlooked, so light, access and privacy come first. Many streets sit within conservation areas, and that is checked before a design is settled.
work: Our London work covers West London, Primrose Hill and central London. Share your postcode and what you are hoping for, and we will reply with how we could help.
